departments.name: Business Strategy & Goals
departments.label: Strategy
departments.business_risk: Without a strategy and monitored goals, growth is accidental; the business stays owner-dependent and exposed to loss of one customer.

growth_recommendations.recommendation: Write a 3-5 year growth strategy with turnover, margin, capacity and market targets
Fix annual turnover and profit targets and split them month-wise
Cascade goals to every department with owners and KPIs
Start a weekly cash-flow review and a monthly management review
Measure customer concentration and set a diversification plan
Prepare a business risk register and a succession plan for key positions
Plan capacity and capex against the 3-year sales forecast

departments.name: KPI & Management Review
departments.label: KPI
departments.business_risk: Without KPIs and a monthly review, problems are found by customers and accountants months late; the same failures repeat.

growth_recommendations.recommendation: Define 3-6 KPIs per department with formula, source, frequency and owner
Set a numeric target for every KPI for the current year
Build the owner's one-page 10-number dashboard
Hold a fixed monthly management review with a standard KPI deck
Introduce an action register and track closure of actions from every review
Start OEE, PPM, OTD and inventory-days measurement where missing
Validate KPI data sources so decisions rest on reliable numbers

departments.name: Human Resources
departments.label: HR
departments.business_risk: Without manpower, skill and retention systems, output and quality depend on individuals and collapse when they leave.

growth_recommendations.recommendation: Approve an organisation chart and job descriptions for all positions
Prepare a manpower plan linked to the production plan
Build a skill matrix and a multi-skilling plan for critical operations
Introduce a structured induction and an annual training calendar
Start a KPI-linked appraisal and a recognition/incentive scheme
Track attrition and absenteeism monthly and act on causes
Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and develop second-line leaders

departments.name: Marketing
departments.label: Marketing
departments.business_risk: Without a marketing system, new enquiries depend on chance; the company cannot replace lost customers or grow into new segments.

growth_recommendations.recommendation: Define target industries and an Ideal Customer Profile
Build a named prospect list of 50-100 target customers
Create a B2B lead-generation system with a monthly lead target
Upgrade the website and Google Business profile; list on B2B portals
Establish a LinkedIn strategy for the company and key people
Prepare professional collateral (profile, presentation, brochure)
Define monthly marketing KPIs and review conversion by channel

departments.name: Sales
departments.label: Sales
departments.business_risk: Without sales targets, pipeline and pricing discipline, turnover is unpredictable and margins are given away.

growth_recommendations.recommendation: Set monthly sales targets by customer and product group with owners
Log every RFQ and measure RFQ and quotation conversion %
Maintain a sales pipeline and review it weekly
Introduce a disciplined follow-up system for open quotations
Standardise quotations on a costing sheet with target margin
Prepare a rolling 3-6 month sales forecast shared with production and purchase
Review order book, receivables and sales KPIs monthly

departments.name: Purchase & Supplier Management
departments.label: Purchase
departments.business_risk: Without supplier control, material cost (50-65% of sales) drifts up and supplier defects and shortages stop production.

growth_recommendations.recommendation: Create an Approved Supplier List and a supplier selection process
Implement a supplier scorecard (Quality, Cost, Delivery, Responsiveness)
Measure supplier PPM and OTD monthly and share ratings with suppliers
Develop alternate suppliers for single-source critical items
Set an annual purchase cost-reduction target with tracked projects
Introduce material planning from the production plan with safety stocks
Plan supplier audits and development for critical suppliers

departments.name: Production
departments.label: Production
departments.business_risk: Without planning, OEE and loss tracking, 25-40% of capacity is lost and deliveries are unreliable.

growth_recommendations.recommendation: Prepare monthly and daily production plans from customer schedules
Calculate capacity by machine/process and identify bottlenecks
Implement OEE on critical machines with daily loss recording
Record downtime by reason and run a daily production meeting
Measure production achievement, productivity and rejection daily
Reduce setup time (SMED) on key machines
Standardise work instructions and implement 5S with performance boards

departments.name: Quality
departments.label: Quality
departments.business_risk: Without quality systems, customer PPM and complaints rise, ratings drop and new business allocation stops.

growth_recommendations.recommendation: Establish incoming, in-process and final inspection with records
Prepare PFMEA and control plans for all processes
Implement a calibration system with status labels and traceable certificates
Start SPC and MSA on critical characteristics
Use 8D for every customer complaint and verify effectiveness
Measure customer PPM, internal rejection and COPQ monthly
Run internal process and product audits with corrective-action tracking

departments.name: Maintenance
departments.label: Maintenance
departments.business_risk: Without preventive maintenance and reliability data, breakdowns dominate, machine life shortens and deliveries fail.

growth_recommendations.recommendation: Classify machines by criticality and start preventive maintenance on all machines
Record every breakdown with cause and duration; analyse monthly
Define and stock critical spares with min/max levels
Calculate MTBF, MTTR and availability for critical machines
Introduce operator autonomous maintenance (daily checklists)
Plan maintenance windows with production and track PM adherence
Track maintenance cost and energy consumption per machine

departments.name: Inventory & Stores
departments.label: Inventory
departments.business_risk: Without inventory control, working capital locks up in stock while production still stops for shortages.

growth_recommendations.recommendation: Define min/max and reorder levels for raw material and critical items
Implement FIFO with location and batch identification
Apply ABC classification and cycle counting
Measure stock accuracy and fix root causes of variance
Report slow-moving, dead and aged stock monthly and dispose with approval
Calculate inventory days for RM, WIP and FG with targets
Organise stores with locations, controlled issues and restricted access
